name: AD811
tagline: ADI current-feedback video amp (2500 V/µs, 25 ns settling) that diyAudio builders use as a very fast DAC I/V stage.

lineage.note: Sole maker. Old copies carry ADI's 1990s 'a' logo; datasheet Rev. D → E in 7/04, now Rev. G.

part_numbers.note: PDIP-8; DigiKey lists it obsolete. DIP units sold for rolling may be old stock.
RoHS PDIP; ADI documentation page lists it as production.
Leaded SOIC-8, J grade; LCSC lists AD811JR discontinued. Octopart files Rev. E under it.
16-lead wide SOIC, RoHS; ADI production. RS plans to drop it.
RoHS SOIC-8, J grade; listed at DigiKey. ADI status not seen.
Leaded wide SOIC-16; DigiKey lists reels obsolete, direct substitute named.
Military CerDIP grade; subject of PCN 11_0182 test-site transfer.

key_specs.value: Not captured; swing ±2.3 V into 75 Ω at ±5 V

reputation.summary: diyAudio posters rate it highly as an I/V converter for current-output DACs, in a dedicated thread, a build thread and the long 'Best opamp for I/V conversion?' thread. They say it beats other op-amps they tried, including an OPA861 alternative, crediting 2500 V/µs and 25 ns settling (vs ~550 ns quoted for OPA627). Forum opinion, not measurements.
caveats: Current feedback: the feedback resistor sets bandwidth and stability; a capacitor across it needs care.
Runs hot; diyAudio posters suggest a small heatsink at ±14 V.
AD811AN DIP-8 is obsolete; newer stock is SOIC (incl. 16-lead wide), so DIP sockets need adapters.
Praise comes from a few diyAudio threads; linking slew or settling to sound is the posters' reasoning.

counterfeit_notes: No AD811 fake reports found. AD811AN (PDIP-8) is obsolete, so cheap DIP-8 AD811s for DAC rolling are old stock at best and may be relabelled. Check date codes and markings, and confirm current-feedback behaviour and very fast edges.

silicon_changes.summary: ADI's AD811 product page lists PCN 11_0182, a test-site transfer for the military AD811SQ/883B. No die or wafer-fab change is described.
silicon_changes.identification: Military /883B grade only; test location change is not visible on the part.
silicon_changes.audio_impact: None expected; back-end test location only.
silicon_changes.compatibility_risk: low: same die and specification; military grade only.
silicon_changes.verification: Listed on the ADI product page; PCN document itself not seen.

claims_confirmed: Current ADI AD811 datasheet is Rev. G, also indexed as 'AD811 (Rev. G)' at the legacy path: https://www.analog.com/static/imported-files/data_sheets/AD811.pdf
RadioLocman copy labelled 'Revision: G', ADI quick links 'Last Content Update: 02/23/2017': https://www.radiolocman.com/datasheet/pdf.html?di=121471&p=1
Rev. E mirrored at Octopart under AD811JR: https://datasheet.octopart.com/AD811JR-Analog-Devices-datasheet-87460.pdf
Rev. D to Rev. E (7/04): updated format, power dissipation, ordering guide, outline dimensions: https://www.mouser.com/datasheet/2/609/AD811-256255.pdf

140/120 MHz BW, 35 MHz 0.1 dB, 2500 V/µs, 25 ns/65 ns settling, 1.9 nV/√Hz, 0.01%/0.01° DG/DP, ±4.5 to ±18 V, ±2.3 V into 75 Ω: https://www.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/data-sheets/AD811.pdf
AD811ARZ-16 listed at RS as a 16-pin wide-SOIC 2500 V/µs video amp: https://nz.rs-online.com/web/p/video-amplifiers-ics/5237689

Revision history: Rev. E to F dated 2/14 (Ordering Guide); Rev. F to G dated 4/15 (Figure 25, Ordering Guide) (https://wcm-cce.cldnet.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/data-sheets/AD811.pdf, https://ja.datasheetq.com/pdf-html/263805-2015/ADI/1page/AD811.html).
A 15-page, 230 KB AD811 copy is listed as REV. D (https://www.alldatasheet.net/datasheet-pdf/pdf/48404/AD/AD811.html).
ADI documentation page lists AD811ANZ and AD811ARZ-16 as production (https://www.analog.com/ad811/documentation?lsrc=doc).
AD811 product page lists PCN 11_0182 (Nov 9, 2011), test site transfer for AD811SQ/883B (https://www.analog.com/en/products/ad811.html).

DigiKey lists AD811AR-16-REEL obsolete; LCSC lists AD811JR discontinued (https://www.digikey.be/en/products/detail/analog-devices-inc/AD811AR-16-REEL/620799, https://datasheet.lcsc.com/lcsc/2002250731_Analog-Devices-AD811JR_C9655.pdf).
